newsitem.title: USA: Checkmate Electronics expects lower Q3 shr.
newsitem.headline: Checkmate Electronics expects lower Q3 shr.

text.p: Checkmate Electronics Inc said Thursday it expects its third-quarter earnings will be "considerably below" analysts' previous estimates of $0.19 to $0.21 per share.
The company attributed the shortfall to delays in major orders that were expected at the end of the third quarter.
Checkmate said most of those orders will ultimately be received. It believes the effect of the shortfall in associated revenue and profit is isolated to this year's third quarter only.
Checkmate develops, manufactures and markets point-of-sale payment automation systems and terminals.
According to First Call, the company's earnings for the 1995 third quarter were $0.14 per share.
